builder_style_calidad_mira: Strong profitability and margins at a sensible price.
builder_style_calidad_cuesta: Excludes companies that do not yet make money, even if they grow fast.
builder_style_maduros_descripcion: Generate cash, distribute it and move less.
builder_style_maduros_mira: Free cash flow, covered dividends, solid margins and low volatility in large companies.
builder_style_maduros_cuesta: Slow growth can lag when the market rewards faster growth.
builder_style_dividendo_descripcion: Pay well without relying on debt.
builder_style_dividendo_mira: High dividends covered by earnings, with little debt.
builder_style_dividendo_cuesta: Usually excludes businesses that reinvest everything to grow.
builder_style_crecimiento_descripcion: Sales grow year after year and the business already earns money.
builder_style_crecimiento_mira: Strong sales growth with margins that show the business works.
builder_style_crecimiento_cuesta: Often expensive: slowing growth can hurt the share price.
builder_style_balance_descripcion: More cash than debt and profitable.
builder_style_balance_mira: Profitable businesses that do not rely on borrowing.
builder_style_balance_cuesta: Plenty of cash can also mean too little investment.
builder_style_castigadas_descripcion: Far below their peak with a low P/E.
builder_style_castigadas_mira: Fallen prices and a low price for each dollar of earnings.
builder_style_castigadas_cuesta: Some have fallen for reasons that still apply.
builder_style_pequenas_descripcion: Small, profitable and with little debt.
builder_style_pequenas_mira: Companies worth $300 million to $2 billion that earn money and owe little.
builder_style_pequenas_cuesta: Prices move more, in both directions.
builder_reglas_impacto: Alone it leaves {sola}; without it {sin} would pass.
builder_reglas_cobertura: {count} out of 100 companies have this data; missing data does not pass.
builder_regla_tamano_mide: Company size on the stock market.
builder_regla_tamano_calculo: Share price multiplied by shares outstanding, in millions of dollars.
builder_regla_barata_calculo: P/E: share price divided by annual earnings per share; earnings must be positive.
builder_regla_pb_calculo: Market capitalization divided by book equity.
builder_regla_ev_ebitda_mide: Business value relative to operating earnings.
builder_regla_ev_ebitda_calculo: Enterprise value divided by EBITDA; the ratio must be positive.
builder_regla_fcf_mide: Free cash flow relative to price.
builder_regla_fcf_calculo: Free cash flow divided by market capitalization, as a percentage.
builder_regla_rentables_calculo: Net income divided by equity, as a percentage.
builder_regla_roa_calculo: Net income divided by total assets, as a percentage.
builder_regla_margen_mide: The share of revenue retained as operating profit.
builder_regla_margen_calculo: Operating income divided by revenue, as a percentage.
builder_regla_margen_neto_mide: The share of revenue retained as net profit.
builder_regla_margen_neto_calculo: Net income divided by revenue, as a percentage.
builder_regla_crecen_calculo: Change in revenue from the same period last year, as a percentage.
builder_regla_deuda_calculo: Debt minus cash, divided by EBITDA. It passes if cash covers debt; otherwise EBITDA must be positive.
builder_regla_caja_neta_calculo: Compares total cash with total debt.
builder_regla_deuda_pn_calculo: Total debt divided by equity, as a percentage.
builder_regla_liquidez_corriente_calculo: Current assets divided by current liabilities.
builder_regla_dividendo_calculo: Annual dividend per share divided by price, as a percentage.
builder_regla_payout_calculo: Dividends divided by net income, as a percentage.
builder_regla_beta_calculo: Provider-estimated beta based on movements in the stock and market.
builder_regla_castigadas_pct_calculo: 52-week high minus price, divided by that high, as a percentage.
builder_regla_fuerza_sp_calculo: Stock 52-week return minus S&P 500 return, in percentage points.
builder_regla_liquidez_calculo: Price multiplied by average daily volume, in millions of dollars.
builder_regla_directivos_calculo: Insider shares divided by total shares, as a percentage.
builder_regla_cortos_calculo: Shares sold short relative to the float, as a percentage.
builder_regla_sin_bancos_calculo: Removes companies whose industry starts with Banks; missing industry data does not pass.
builder_regla_sin_tabaco_calculo: Removes companies in the Tobacco industry.
builder_regla_solo_sectores_calculo: The company sector must be in the selected list.
builder_regla_sin_sectores_calculo: The company sector must be outside the selected list.
